description: Pakistan Cables Limited was conceived in 1953 by the late Amir S. Chinoy and is one of Pakistan's longest-established cable manufacturers. It operated under the authority of British Insulated Callender's Cables between 1953 and 1993, and produces wires and cables, PVC compounds and wiring accessories.
sourceNote: Company website (pakistancables.com: home, our products, management team), read 2026-10-17.

products.name: Wires and cables
products.summary: General wiring cables, and low- and medium-voltage power cables, made with 99.99% pure copper and cable-grade PVC.

products.name: PVC compound
products.summary: Flexible PVC compounds for cable insulation and sheathing, produced at a dedicated plant since 2007.
